label: Pass defense production
definition: Who makes the play after the catch. The feed names the tackler, the break-up and the interceptor, never the defender in coverage, so per-defender targets allowed do not exist; catches tackled is the closest honest measure and is labelled that way. Team pass-defense rates (EPA, success, explosives, havoc by DBs) and the allowed depth x direction grid are Team Analytics'; group-level allowed numbers are in the receiving file's defense side.

garbage_time.policy: Dual-surfaced: `all` counts every snap; `competitive` drops garbage time (play_filters.is_garbage_time).

team.label: Catches with a named tackler
team.definition: Completions where the feed names a tackler (the rest went out of bounds, scored, or were not credited).

team.label: Tackles after the catch by DBs
team.definition: Share of catches with a named tackler where a DB made the tackle (a shared tackle counts for each group).

team.label: Tackles after the catch by LBs
team.definition: Share of catches with a named tackler where a LB made the tackle (a shared tackle counts for each group).

team.label: Tackles after the catch by DLs
team.definition: Share of catches with a named tackler where a DL made the tackle (a shared tackle counts for each group).

players.label: Catches tackled
players.definition: Completions on which he made (or shared) the tackle.

players.label: Yards per catch tackled
players.definition: Credited yards on those catches / catches tackled. Not coverage: the feed never names the defender in coverage.

players.label: Yards after catch per catch tackled
players.definition: Yards after the catch on those catches (charted spots).

players.label: Deep catches among his tackles
players.definition: Catches 13+ air yards downfield (charting.pass_depth_band) / catches tackled with a charted spot.

player_qualify: sample (catches tackled) >= 1 per team game; ranks are among qualified players only
notes: Interceptions, break-ups and pass-rush counts per player are in 90-Output/{season}/season_{season}.json players; not counted again here.
